name: NFO Custom Merge ID
description: Jellyfin groups series across release folders by MetadataProvider.Custom, ahead of TVDB and IMDb, but nothing registers that id - so a <customid> element in a tvshow.nfo is dropped without a word. This plugin registers it. Two release folders can then be forced apart or held together from disk, and the decision survives a rebuild of the database.
overview: Makes <customid> readable from a tvshow.nfo, so series grouping is decided on disk.

versions.changelog: First release. Registers MetadataProvider.Custom as an external id, so a customid element in a tvshow.nfo is read instead of being silently dropped. Series that must stay apart get different values, release folders that belong together get the same one - and because the value lives on disk, the decision survives a rebuild of the database. Applies to series, and needs the library option for automatic series grouping.
